inherited.M01: Open-loop screening of cued overt or covert vowels and rest (2-3 s cues), then closed-loop use; BCI2000 screening lineage (Leuthardt 2004, Schalk 2008a).
inherited.M02: No training-only signal; labels are the cued task.
inherited.M03: Per-patient feature selection by screening r2 and a ~1 min normaliser; no cross-session calibration.
inherited.M06: Weighted sum of selected electrode-frequency power features, normalised to cursor velocity; BCI2000 ECoG cursor lineage.
inherited.M07: No language model or lexicon; binary choice.
inherited.M08: 1-D cursor velocity to one of two targets (motor ECoG cursor lineage).
inherited.M09: Selection by the cursor reaching a target; no confirmation step.
inherited.M11: Ground truth is the cued target side.
inherited.M13: Acute epilepsy monitoring with clinical grids for about one week; burr-hole argument is the authors' projection.
